summary: Repaired the current native failure in the bounded annular-bore probe: each square-hole plate rib is now an immobile kinematic rigid body, enabling filtered contact sensing in the pinned Isaac Lab runtime while preserving fixture physics. The probe remains limited to compound annulus geometry, mass properties, 6 mm bore passage, and 10 mm washer-only support; no segmented-washer or full-environment qualification is claimed.
